title: 第2章 大哥？给我滚！
novel_title: 乱世武道：从山村猎户开始狂肝箭术
content_zh:
“嫂子，我来。”

    感受到陆林目光中的坚定。

    梁心兰犹豫一瞬，眉宇间露出一丝担心。

    “小叔，相公他许是喝醉了，你莫要跟他计较。”

    “嗯。”

    陆林点头，“嫂子，你先吃面，我去去就来。”

    陆林已经迫不及待想要见一见，记忆中的禽兽大哥了。

    推开房门，寒风扑面而来。

    陆林眯了眯眼睛。

    “哐哐哐。”

    “开门！开门！”

    “你个臭娘们，快给老子开门。”

    聒噪声被寒风送入陆林耳边。

    陆林脸上升起一丝不耐。

    “砰。”

    陆林用力拉开门栓，正要用力砸门的陆杨砸了个空。

    身子不由自主向前踉跄了两步。

    陆林闪身避开。

    一股难闻的酒味弥散开来。

    陆杨身高八尺，体型肥硕。

    好不容易把身形稳住，陆杨迷离着眼睛，这才看到陆林。

    “哼，你个小畜生，还没死啊！”

    “去，给老子打一桶，一桶洗脚水去。”

    许是习惯了欺负陆林。

    陆杨的巴掌，毫不客气打向陆林的脸。

    陆林一把抓住他的手腕。

    “洗脚？就在院子里洗吧。”

    陆林将陆杨推开。

    兄弟二人都是一个爹妈生的，陆林比陆杨还要高出一截，只是看起来瘦弱了些。

    他这一推，陆杨吃不住，倒退几步，一屁股坐在地上。

    “你，你敢打我？”

    “果然是个小畜生，今天，老子要好好教训，教训你，让你知道，谁，谁是大哥！”

    陆杨挣扎着站起来。

    还没等他动手，陆林就一脚踹过去。

    “啊呀——”

    陆杨惨叫一声，仰面跌倒。

    “滚！”

    陆林冷喝。

    陆杨这时候酒也醒了大半，见到平时任他欺负的陆林，今天竟然敢对他出手，当即怒气上涌。

    “你个小王八蛋，这几年要不是老子，你早死了八百回了，还敢跟我动手！”

    陆杨爬起来，目光四下扫视。

    他也知道，自己喝多了不是陆林的对手。

    陆杨双目一亮，迈开大步，在院墙边拿起一把铁锹。

    “小畜生，老子今天打死你！”

    陆杨举起铁锹，就要冲着陆林的脑袋拍下来。
content_en:
"Sister-in-law, I'm coming."

    Feel the determination in Lu Lin's eyes.

    Liang Xinlan hesitated for a moment, with a hint of worry on her brows.

    "Uncle, my husband may be drunk. Don't argue with him."

    "Yeah."

    Lu Lin nodded, "Sister-in-law, you eat noodles first, I'll come back when I'm gone."

    Lu Lin couldn't wait to meet the beast brother in his memory.

    Pushing open the door, the cold wind blew in my face.

    Lu Lin narrowed his eyes.

    "Bang bang bang."

    "Open the door! Open the door!"

    "You stinky bitch, open the door for me."

    The chattering noise was carried into Lu Lin's ears by the cold wind.

    A hint of impatience rose on Lu Lin's face.

    "Bang."

    Lu Lin pulled the door latch forcefully, but Lu Yang, who was about to slam the door hard, missed it.

    His body involuntarily staggered forward two steps.

    Lu Lin dodged to avoid it.

    An unpleasant smell of alcohol spread.

    Lu Yang is eight feet tall and has a plump build.

    After finally stabilizing his body, Lu Yang's eyes were blurred, and then he saw Lu Lin.

    "Humph, you little beast, you're not dead yet!"

    "Go and get me a bucket of water to wash my feet."

    Xu was used to bullying Lu Lin.

    Lu Yang's slap hit Lu Lin's face unceremoniously.

    Lu Lin grabbed his wrist.

    "Wash your feet? Just wash your feet in the yard."

    Lu Lin pushed Lu Yang away.

    The two brothers were born to the same parents. Lu Lin was taller than Lu Yang, but he looked a little thinner.

    With his push, Lu Yang couldn't stand it, so he took a few steps back and sat down on the ground.

    "You, you dare to hit me?"

    "You are indeed a little beast. Today, I will teach you a lesson and let you know who is the big brother!"

    Lu Yang struggled to stand up.

    Before he could make a move, Lu Lin kicked him over.

    "Ah--"

    Lu Yang screamed and fell on his back.

    "Get out!"

    Lu Lin drank coldly.

    Lu Yang was mostly sober from drinking at this time. When he saw that Lu Lin, who was usually bullied by him, dared to attack him today, he immediately became angry.

    "You little bastard, if it hadn't been for me in the past few years, you would have died eight hundred times, and yet you dare to attack me!"

    Lu Yang got up and looked around.

    He also knew that he was no match for Lu Lin if he drank too much.

    Lu Yang's eyes lit up, he took big steps and picked up a shovel by the courtyard wall.

    "You little beast, I will beat you to death today!"

    Lu Yang raised the shovel and was about to hit Lu Lin on the head.
title_en: Chapter 2 Big Brother? Get out of here!
